newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid's general index breaks resistance at 400.
newsitem.headline: Madrid's general index breaks resistance at 400.

text.p: Madrid's general stock index climbed higher to break key resistance at 400 on Thursday, boosted by strength in blue-chip stocks, traders said.
The general index rose 4.10 points, 1.04 percent to 400.06. The Ibex-35 index rose 1.14 percent to 3,618.54.
Traders said strength in Endesa, Telefonica and Repsol had helped drag the index higher.
